newsitem.title: USA: America Online holders file to sell shares.
newsitem.headline: America Online holders file to sell shares.

text.p: America Online Inc said Monday in a shelf registration filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission that some of its shareholders offered up to 1,006,942 common shares for sale.

The largest selling shareholders include AT&T Corp with 480,786 shares for sale, Draper Associates II LP with 278,464 common and Peter Burnight with 47,210 common shares. The filing did not identify Burnight.
The stock sale is not underwritten, the company said in the filing.
American Online, based in Dulles, Va., is engaged in the interactive services market with nearly $1.1 billion in revenue during fiscal 1996.
